title: Nine Words on a Page
subtitle: 会议与议程 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 会议与议程（社会服务与人际沟通·会议与协商）
meta: 主题语境：会议与议程（社会服务与人际沟通·会议与协商）　|　核心词汇：agenda　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 agenda 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 my grandmother wrote the ① agenda for a meeting of nine people and said an agenda is the list of things that will be talked about, which is not the same as the list of things that matter. Whoever writes the ② agenda, she said, has already won half of the meeting, and she wrote it for thirty-one years.

The flooding was ③ on the agenda nine times between 1961 and 1971 and was never once discussed, and she said being on the agenda is the polite way of not doing a thing. My father said there was a ④ hidden agenda, meaning the chairman's field at the bottom of the hill, and she said there is always one and it is always a field.

In 1974 the chairman's clerk began to ⑤ set the agenda, and my grandmother said the change was nine words on a page and the whole of the rest of her life. The bus shelter was at the ⑥ top of the agenda every year from 1961, and it was never once reached, and she said an agenda is a queue in which the last thing never moves.

She kept her own ⑦ agenda in a notebook for forty years, which was five things a day and none of them about the meeting, and nobody has ever read it. The  agenda she typed in 1981, meaning the sheet of paper itself, had nine items and a coffee stain, and my father kept it; an agenda, she said, should fit on one side of one page.

The ⑧ agenda I suspect, if I am honest, is not hers but the chairman's, which was never written down and never needed to be. An  agenda, she told me in 1988, is the only document in the world that is written before the thing and never after it, and that is why it is the only one anybody argues about.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 议程；议事日程
B. n. （个人的）待办事项；日程
D. n. 议程表；议程文件
E. 固定搭配：on the agenda 在议程上；列入议程
F. 固定搭配：hidden agenda 隐秘的意图；不可告人的目的
G. 固定搭配：set the agenda 制定议程；主导议题
H. 固定搭配：the top of the agenda 议程首位；头等大事

items.q: the agenda for a meeting of nine
was on the agenda nine times
at the top of the agenda every year
her own agenda in a notebook

answers.why: agenda 意为“议程、议事日程”，1969 年祖母为一场九个人的会议写议程。
agenda 意为“议程文件、议程表”，她说谁写这份议程文件，谁就已经赢了一半的会。
on the agenda 意为“在议程上、列入议程”，洪水的事九次列入议程却从未被讨论。
hidden agenda 意为“隐秘的意图、不可告人的目的”，父亲说主席真正在意的是山下那块地。
set the agenda 意为“制定议程”，1974 年主席的办事员开始拟定议程。
the top of the agenda 意为“议程首位”，公交候车亭自 1961 年起年年列在议程首位，却从未被讨论到。
agenda 意为“（个人的）待办事项、日程”，她自己的本子上记的是每天五件事，与会议无关。
agenda 意为“（隐秘的）意图、目的”，我怀疑的那份意图不是她的，而是主席的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年祖母为一场九个人的会议写议程，她说议程是将要被讨论的事，并不是要紧的事。（agenda）
她说，谁写这份议程文件，谁就已经赢了一半的会。（agenda）
洪水的事在 1961 到 1971 年间九次列入议程，却从未被讨论过。（on the agenda）
父亲说其中有一份不可告人的目的——主席在山下那块地。（hidden agenda）
1974 年主席的办事员开始制定议程，她说这个变化就是纸上的九个词。（set the agenda）
她说，议程是世上唯一在事情发生之前写好、之后从不重写的文件。（agenda）
answers: In 1969 my grandmother wrote the agenda for a meeting of nine people and said it is the list of things that will be talked about.
Whoever writes the agenda, she said, has already won half of the meeting.
The flooding was on the agenda nine times between 1961 and 1971 and was never once discussed.
My father said there was a hidden agenda, meaning the chairman's field at the bottom of the hill.
In 1974 the chairman's clerk began to set the agenda, and she said the change was nine words on a page.
An agenda, she said, is the only document that is written before the thing and never after it.
